{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Navy Transmission''', also known as '''INavTrans''' was a communication system standard used by [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] computers. [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were equipped with software that allowed them to communicate with computers that used the Imperial Navy Transmission standard.<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
